headline: One Worker Killed Following Explosion At Oil Refinery In Cepu Blora
seoTitle: Worker Killed in Cepu Oil Refinery Explosion
metaDescription: A fatal explosion at the PPSDM Migas oil refinery in Cepu, Blora has resulted in the death of one worker, prompting an investigation by authorities.
aiSummaryBullets: One worker died from severe burns after a tank explosion occurred at the PPSDM Migas oil refinery facility in Cepu, Blora.
Initial reports suggest the incident may have been triggered by residual gas remaining inside a storage tank during a cleaning operation.
The Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources has launched a formal investigation to determine the definitive cause of the explosion.
aiContextParagraph: On November 18, 2026, an explosion occurred at the Pusat Pengembangan Sumber Daya Manusia (PPSDM) Minyak dan Gas refinery located in the Cepu district of Blora, Central Java. The incident involved a storage tank at the facility and resulted in the death of one worker, who reportedly sustained burns covering 90 percent of their body. In response to the event, the Ministry of Energy and Mineral Resources confirmed the fatality and initiated a comprehensive investigation. Preliminary assessments by officials and local police suggest the explosion was likely triggered by gas residue left inside a tank that was being cleaned at the time of the accident. The incident drew significant attention due to the intensity of the blast, which witnesses described as sounding similar to an aircraft crash.
whyItIsViral: The incident is viral due to coverage by six independent news outlets and a very high rate of reporting velocity following the fatal event.
